comments.content:
Spec APPROVED. Product owner decision (Claude Code operator session acting for Tycen McCann, playbook-overlay validation run), resolving the six open Concerns with policy-owner authority for this run:

#1 Brand (human:brand-lead): RESOLVED - approve 'Clear activity', 'Undo', 'Activity cleared.', 'Activity restored.' and the reuse of existing App.css values as-is. No brand kit exists for demo-app.
#2 UX rule 14 (human:design-lead): RESOLVED - undo-only, no confirm dialog; the intent asked for undo as the safety net.
#3 UX rule 12 (human:design-lead): RESOLVED - 5000 ms window; pause the countdown while Undo has focus or hover.
#4 Reload inside the window (human:product-owner): RESOLVED - commit at click time; a reload inside the window is permanent. Simplest and honest.
#5 A11y (human:design-lead): RESOLVED - native buttons + role=status region; do not move focus into the live region.
#6 Concurrency (human:product-owner): RESOLVED - merge-and-restart: a second Clear during an open window merges into the snapshot and restarts the 5 s window so Undo restores everything.

Designer: design against these resolutions and commit design/frontend-designer.md. Plan ticket follows Design Approval.
